verdict.rationale: GrowthBook lists a named "Safe rollouts" feature on its paid tier, supports guardrail metrics in experiment configuration, and documents release plans that ramp a rule automatically, so metric-guarded rollouts are its own claimed capability. The pack never describes how Safe rollouts detect a regression or whether they roll back on their own; the only evidence is a one-line pricing bullet. missing for 10: documentation of how Safe rollouts monitor guardrail metrics, evidence of automatic rollback on regression, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can guard a rollout with metrics so a regression is detected and the release is rolled back automatically

citations.quote: a value-serving rule can ramp up automatically over time instead of switching on all at once
